cs.t: Despite having a single dedicated key on my keyboard that opens speedcrunch, I will always reach for my trusty Casio calculator that I bought 20 years ago in school.
cs.th: Ask HN: Do you still use a hand held/desktop calculator?

cs.t:
I bought a cheap casio one while reading through a book on basic financial hygiene for entrepreneurs. Over time, an excel sheet has replaced it. For quick and dirty calculations, I launch a repl in my terminal. 
So, Excel > REPL > Physical desktop calculator > calculator application on my computer.
cs.th: Ask HN: Do you still use a hand held/desktop calculator?
